issues.description: The problem statement and UML require that each class has a public constructor taking all attributes in the order defined by the UML (Ride must accept name and abbreviation). In the solution, Ride only defines a constructor Ride(String name) and sets abbreviation to a default, while RollerCoaster and subclasses call super(name, abbreviation) or expect a two-argument Ride constructor. This mismatch violates the specified constructor signatures and leads to a compilation error (RollerCoaster calls a non-existent Ride(String, char) constructor).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the Ride constructor with the UML and problem requirements by adding a public constructor Ride(String name, char abbreviation) that assigns both fields. Update any existing one-argument constructors or calls accordingly (e.g., ensure RollerCoaster calls super(name, abbreviation) and Ride stores the provided abbreviation), so constructors across the inheritance chain match the specified parameter order and types.
